caption: The drawing depicts a round, flat object resembling a decorative metal plate or medallion, rendered realistically in shades of brown, gold, and bluish-grey. The circular object features a wide border that contains an inscription made up of stylized letters in a continuous ring around the perimeter. The central area of the plate appears textured and raised, showing the image of a swan with an elongated neck, lying or swimming on a surface with a background of indistinct organic shapes that suggest foliage or water. The plate has areas of darker and lighter brown, indicating variations in the metal’s patina or corrosion, and the surrounding area of the plate is depicted as a plain, light tan or beige surface. There is a small signature in the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Pa. German Dish
